name: Handwoven sabai grass roti / chapati box with lid, approx. 8 in (Odisha handicraft)
supplier_cost_note: Sigmascott Pvt Ltd, Bhubaneswar (Odisha): 'Natural Sabai Grass Handmade Chapati Box - 8x8 inch' approx. Rs 299, MOQ 50 (TradeIndia, seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshot). Same seller on IndiaMART: round basket with lid Rs 249 and Rs 349 (natural), round chapati basket Rs 199. A Baripada (Mayurbhanj) maker lists a round sabai grass chapati box at Rs 200/piece (lid not confirmed) - at Rs 200 the margin rises to ~41-46%. Get a quote with lid type and photos.
retail_observed: Prista sabai grass roti box with lid Rs 749-899 across listings (product page Rs 769, MRP 1,599; 4.4 stars / 25 reviews per snapshot), Amazon.in; Bhumee Creations 9x9x3 in roti casserole ~Rs 854 (Flipkart, MRP 1,900); KADAM HAAT with wooden lid ~Rs 999 (Amazon.in). Cheaper adjacent: Meesho small sabai basket with lid Rs 255 (not a roti box). Seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshots.

demand_signals.source: Amazon.in: Prista Handcrafted Sabai Grass Roti Box with Lid
demand_signals.summary: Listing shows 4.4 stars from 25 reviews and several price points/variants (Rs 749-899): evidence of some sales, no volume data
Multiple sellers (Prista, KADAM HAAT, Aranya Shilpo, Bhumee Creations, Bhartiye Crafts) offer sabai roti boxes; niche but active

risks: Food-contact use: do NOT claim 'food grade', 'keeps rotis hot' or insulation without evidence; KADAM HAAT reviews say rotis dry out and it keeps warm only ~30 min
Hand wash only; moisture/mould if stored damp - care card needed
Volumetric weight of a ~23 cm box (23x23x10 cm ~1.06 kg) may tip into le_2kg; at le_2kg margin falls below 30% unless cost is ~Rs 200
Margin is thin at Rs 299 cost: Amazon ~31%, Shopify/Flipkart/Meesho 27-28% at Rs 749; needs the Rs 200 maker price or Rs 799
GST: HSN 4602 basketwork; 5% assumed - CA to confirm

review.notes: At the quoted Rs 299 cost the box passes 30% only on Amazon (31.4%) and only if it ships in le_1kg; an 8x8 in box packed at ~23x23x10 cm is volumetric ~1.06 kg (le_2kg), where every channel falls to 18-26%, and the Sigmascott 'chapati box' snippet does not confirm a lid. Needs a written quote for the exact 8 in box with fitted lid (Baripada maker at ~Rs 200, which gives 41-46%, or Rs 299 sold at Rs 799 -> 31-36%), plus packed dimensions/weight (The India Craft House's comparable 8-9.5 in basket is 540 g); list as a storage/serving basket only, no 'food grade', hygiene or keeps-warm claims.
